geometry: Semelle rectangulaire a aretes arrondies, dalle superieure sombre a pourtour arrondi, marche transversale arriere claire. Stele irreguliere a sommet dominant central/decale a droite et epaulement montagneux plus bas a gauche; chants eclates. Galet clair pose a gauche.
fixed_features: Contour montagneux et chants eclates de la stele
Dalle superieure sombre a bord arrondi
removable_accessories: Galet clair pose a l'avant gauche, probablement decoratif
material_zones: Composition bicolore: semelle et marche arriere claires veinees, dalle superieure et facade de stele sombres. Paysage blanc de montagnes/sapins en facade.
ambiguity: Le paysage frontal semble une gravure de surface; le galet pourrait etre une plaque ovale. Le point sombre dans la stele est un reflet du galet, pas une seconde pierre posee.
generation_note: Conserver bicolore et silhouette montagneuse; si galet retire, retirer aussi son reflet. Ne pas confondre ce modele avec montagne01.
decisionPilote: Distinct de Montagne01 par silhouette et bicolore. Semelle et marche claires restent fixes; dalle superieure et stele varient. Gravure optionnelle retiree. Galet traite comme accessoire pose, fixation non visible; son reflet frontal sombre n'est pas une seconde piece.

specificationGeneration.geometry: a compact cinerary monument with a light rectangular plinth and rear step, a dark upper slab with rounded edges, and a thick irregular mountain-shaped upright with a high peak slightly right of center
specificationGeneration.stoneAreas: only the upper slab and the mountain-shaped headstone, which are dark stone in the source, including the headstone's rough exposed edges
specificationGeneration.fixedAreas: Keep the lower projecting plinth and rear transverse step in their original light grey-white veined stone. Preserve the bicolor boundaries. Keep the headstone edges rough as an unpolished finish of the variable headstone stone.
specificationGeneration.extraConstraints: Preserve the dominant peak slightly right of center and the lower mountain shoulder on the left. Do not substitute the left-high skyline of Montagne01. Keep the upper slab's rounded perimeter.
specificationGeneration.masterDescription: Preserve the rectangular lowest plinth with softened edges, the slightly inset thick upper slab with a rounded perimeter, the transverse rear supporting step, and the thick mountain-shaped headstone. Its highest point lies slightly right of center with a lower shoulder on the left. Preserve its irregular chipped perimeter. The light lower plinth and rear step are fixed secondary stone; the dark upper slab and headstone are variable primary stone.
specificationGeneration.removeDescription: Remove the white mountain-and-pine-tree surface engraving and the loose light oval pebble on the front-left slab. Remove the pebble's reflections in the slab and headstone. Preserve all actual peaks and rough edges.
specificationGeneration.interpretationNote: Distinct de Montagne01 par silhouette et bicolore. Semelle et marche claires restent fixes; dalle superieure et stele varient. Gravure optionnelle retiree. Galet traite comme accessoire pose, fixation non visible; son reflet frontal sombre n'est pas une seconde piece.
